decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the porch and insertion of windows hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the porch is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north wall of the porch hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey front/side infill extension to provide a front entrance porch and the installation of two windows to the side elevation, one at ground floor and one at first floor level
